description: Audit-lane owned registry for Tier-A accepted non-axiom premise handling. Genuine admitted derivation targets are two: AC_phi_lambda and theta. Record is no longer Tier-A; Admissibility and Record are included in the explicitly approved four-axiom minimal_axioms node. The scale reference a^-1 is likewise not a Tier-A admission; it is registered as the explicitly approved framework primitive scale_reference_primitive in axiom_premise_nodes.json. Derivation targets are accepted as chain-satisfying premises at the bounded tier, so a clean row depending on one resolves to retained_bounded rather than retained_pending_chain; when a target is derived, remove its entry and compute_effective_status will auto-cascade dependents toward unbounded retained status when otherwise eligible. Y0 and g0 are vacuous rescaling conventions listed for survey completeness only: not admitted inputs, not derivation targets, not accepted premises, and not status-bounding dependencies. This registry is distinct from axiom_premise_nodes.json and from standard textbook theorems, which must earn retained-grade inline. Human-readable registry: docs/ADMITTED_INPUT_REGISTRY_TIER_A_NOTE_2026-05-23.md. 2026-06-11 minimum-statement sharpening (owner-approved): both statements restated at their sharpest landed decomposition; no admission added, removed, adopted, or re-graded; count unchanged; no_go_portfolio lists unchanged (verified rows only); sharpening_sources fields list landed source notes whose audit status is set only by the audit lane. 2026-07-04 AC_phi_lambda(i) value-face reclassification: the per-lane occupancy value is realized-state registered data under realized_state_primitive, not a Tier-A derivation target; the surviving AC(i) residual is the measure-side/dynamical realization binary. 2026-07-04 AC_phi_lambda(iii) C3-grade species-bridge owner ratification: the contentless C3-grade abstract-sector to physical-species identification is retired from Tier-A by owner path-extension and grade-scoped ratification; above-C3 taste/Dirac/chirality content and CKM/PMNS alignment are not covered. Count unchanged because AC_phi_lambda remains Tier-A through AC(i) and AC(ii), and theta is untouched. Human-readable decompositions: docs/ADMITTED_INPUT_REGISTRY_TIER_A_NOTE_2026-05-23.md, minimum-statement section.

staggered_dirac_realization_gate_note_20.label: AC_phi_lambda
staggered_dirac_realization_gate_note_20.statement: minimum form (2026-07-04 after partial reclassifications): two surviving Tier-A residual atoms -- (i) the measure-side doublet occupancy realization binary: which grain/statistics the matter action implements (sector-tied/count-twice vs orbit/holomorphic/count-once; K-reality and det_C/equal-power are its measure-side faces). The per-lane r value in {1, 1/2} is registered realized-state data, not a Tier-A derivation target; (ii) the delta readout identification R-eta (density-read-as-angle; the magnitude 2/9 is retained-bounded fixed-locus arithmetic conditional on R-eta, not an admitted number). The species bridge C3-grade leg is owner-ratified naming-class content, not a Tier-A derivation target. Above-C3 taste/Dirac/chirality content, hw1-vs-hw2 carrier content beyond the C3 grade, and CKM/PMNS across-fermion-type alignment are not covered and require separate derivation, explicit admission, or approved primitive registration if later used. Bare e/mu/tau naming remains a vacuous convention, not a derivation target.
staggered_dirac_realization_gate_note_20.class: discrete flavor input with labeling convention stripped

reading_occupancy_selection_value_face.boundary: Only the per-lane value face moves out of Tier-A. The measure-side/dynamical realization binary remains part of AC_phi_lambda.

species_bridge_c3_grade.boundary: Only the C3-structural-grade abstract-sector to physical-species identification moves out of Tier-A. Taste/Dirac/chirality content, hw1-vs-hw2 carrier content beyond the C3 grade, CKM/PMNS alignment, AC(i), AC(ii), and theta remain outside this reclassification.

strong_cp_theta_zero_note.label: theta
strong_cp_theta_zero_note.statement: minimum form (2026-06-11), with theta_bar = theta_gauge + arg det(M_q): (a) gauge side -- theta_gauge = 0 in the topological-sector weighting, residual localized to the multi-plaquette / large-gauge-winding account (within the supplied per-plaquette class the local cross-plane F Ftilde slot is derived-absent; RP, reality, positivity, CPT, parity-measure, and arrow-orientation are tracked in landed source notes as non-forcing/non-sourcing route surfaces); (b) mass side -- the discrete orientation arg det M in {0, pi} -> 0 on the K-real reading, localized onto the named determinant-readout bridge. The mass-side K-real structure is the same C_3 conjugate-symmetric object as AC_phi_lambda sub-admission (i). Also unsolved in the Standard Model.

hypercharge_identification_note.label: Y0
hypercharge_identification_note.statement: absolute hypercharge normalization (alpha=1/3); the retained structure fixes ratios, while the overall Y-scale is a Y <-> g' rescaling convention with no physical content by itself
hypercharge_identification_note.basis: koide_y_substrate_anomaly_forcing_note_2026-05-08_probey_substrate_anomaly (retained_bounded): anomaly fixes ratios not absolute normalization

g_bare_rigidity_theorem_note.label: g0
g_bare_rigidity_theorem_note.class: vacuous rescaling convention (g <-> beta gauge choice)
g_bare_rigidity_theorem_note.basis: beta_gbare_rescaling_abstract_identity_narrow_theorem_note_2026-05-10 (retained): g_bare is rescaling-invariant convention, not a number to derive

minimal_axioms_record.label: Record axiom
minimal_axioms_record.statement: fixed locking of exactly one admissible local possibility when a record is present, one-record-per-site uniqueness, record permanence, and scalar-valued record readout finitely additive over finite pairwise-disjoint record collections; registered inside the explicitly approved minimal_axioms node, not as a Tier-A admitted derivation target
minimal_axioms_record.boundary: does not supply readout-context selection, decomposition, K/CPT structure, sector-generation rule, weighting, normalization, probability, occurrence rule, update law, measurement/decoherence dynamics, record-production dynamics, physical persistence dynamics, time metric, within-sector data, occupancy rule, P2/modulus, log-det, source/action, scale, local observability, or arbitrary observable identification

scale_reference_primitive.label: scale-reference primitive
scale_reference_primitive.statement: the single dimensionful scale reference a^-1, accepted as a framework primitive in axiom_premise_nodes.json; units conversion only, not a Tier-A admitted derivation target and not a status-bounding dependency
